# Ring announcer lines

The game plays `<file>.mp3` from this folder for each line (fights 3–5 intros). A missing file falls back to the browser voice.
Voice direction: booming professional boxing ring announcer, deep male voice, big arena, long drawn-out names. Keep each clip under ~5 s.

| File | Line |
|---|---|
| `welcome-regional.mp3` | Ladies and gentlemen! Welcome... to the Regional Championship! |
| `welcome-national.mp3` | Ladies and gentlemen! Welcome... to the National Championship! |
| `welcome-title.mp3` | Ladies and gentlemen! This is the main event... for the championship of the world! |
| `red-the-spark.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... The Spark! |
| `red-cyclone.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Cyclone! |
| `red-haymaker.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Haymaker! |
| `red-bulldozer.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Bulldozer! |
| `red-the-comet.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... The Comet! |
| `red-thunderclap.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Thunderclap! |
| `red-wildcard.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Wildcard! |
| `red-firecracker.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Firecracker! |
| `red-blitz.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Blitz! |
| `red-the-rookie.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... The Rookie! |
| `red-neon.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Neon! |
| `red-afterburner.mp3` | In the red corner... the challenger... Afterburner! |
| `blue-regional.mp3` | And in the blue corner... Ivan... The Wall... Petrov! |
| `blue-national.mp3` | And in the blue corner... Marco... El Toro... Ruiz! |
| `blue-title.mp3` | And in the blue corner... the reigning champion of the world... Jordan... King... Hayes! |
